errors.text_span: червена плътна линия, обозначаваща стойността на договорите в милиони лева
errors.evidence: The line representing стойност (value) is orange, not red, as clearly shown in the legend and the figure.

errors.text_span: Синята линия започва от 719 през 2013 г., намалява до 519 през 2015 г., след това отново се увеличава до 985 през 2017 г., откъдето започва да намалява като достига 645 през 2019 г., 655 през 2020 г.
errors.evidence: The blue line values are misread: it increases from 719 (2013) to 825 (2014), drops to 519 (2015), then to 186 (2016), then rises to 645 (2017), 655 (2018), 752 (2019), 852 (2020). The value 985 belongs to the orange line (стойност), not the blue line (брой). Also, 645 corresponds to 2017, not 2019; and 655 to 2018, not 2020.

errors.text_span: Червената линия започва от 1828,2 през 2013 г.
errors.evidence: The orange (value) line starts at 3203,4 in 2013, not 1828,2. The value 1828,2 corresponds to 2014.
The peak of 2990,5 occurs in 2019, not 2017. In 2017, the orange line shows 985,8.

errors.text_span: спада до 1946,9 през 2019 г., 2818,2 през 2021 г. и 2847,2 през 2022г.
errors.evidence: The values and years are wrong: 1946,9 corresponds to 2021, not 2019; 2847,2 corresponds to 2020, not 2022; 2818,2 corresponds to 2022, not 2021.
The description does not mention that the blue line reaches its minimum of 186 in 2016, which is a key data point highlighted in both the figure and the reference description.

The description mentions a Y-axis with scale up to approximately 3200 and intervals of 200, but the figure does not show explicit Y-axis tick labels; data labels are shown directly on the lines. Also, both lines share the same X-axis but have very different scales, which is not clarified.

The blue line value for 2021 is 764, which is correct, but the sequence stated is wrong — the description says values go 645 (2019), 655 (2020), 764 (2021), when in reality 645=2017, 655=2018, 752=2019, 852=2020, 764=2021.
